none: PAS LIN-0E52F5: Roman silver finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver Roman finger ring inscribed TOT. The hoop is D-shaped in cross-section and expands gently towards the bezel. The bezel has a crude trapezoid panel formed by incised lines. The panel contains the inscription TOT, which is an abbreviation for the celtic god-name Toutatis/Totatis. Similar rings are well known finds from the East Midlands, especially in Lincolnshire. This is ring number 68…
